chunks: They want to extinguish the light of God by uttering blasphemies. But God wills to perfect His light, however the unbelievers may dislike it.
ai.seo_question: How does God perfect His light despite the disbelievers' efforts to extinguish it?
ai.summary: In Surah As-Saff, this verse highlights the futile attempts of the disbelievers to extinguish Allah's light through their speech, contrasting human effort with divine decree. Shia scholars often interpret 'light' here as the guidance of the Prophet and the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing that despite the opposition of the Kuffar, Allah will perfect this light through the establishment of justice and the finality of prophethood.
